# import libraries 
library(dplyr)

# Read flight data from 2004 to 2008 & adding a year column to the dataframe
years <- 2004:2008
file_names <- paste0(years, ".csv.bz2")

flights_df <- lapply(seq_along(file_names), function(i) {
  df <- read.csv(file_names[i])
  return(df)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()
  
# a) find best times of day and days of week to min. delays each yr

# Data cleaning of flights_df 

# removing unnecessary columns in dataframe for analysis & excluding flight data where flights were cancelled or diverted and departure, arrivals >=2400
flights_filtered <- flights_df %>% 
  select(-TaxiIn, -TaxiOut, -CancellationCode,
         -CarrierDelay,-WeatherDelay, -SecurityDelay, -NASDelay, -LateAircraftDelay) %>%
  filter(Cancelled == 0 & Diverted == 0 & DepTime < 2400 & ArrTime < 2400) 

# mutating flights_filtered to find the distance of flights by km & adding another column,delay, based on arrival delay and grouping them by early, on-time, small delay, medium delay, long-delay
flights_filtered <- flights_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    delay_category = case_when(
      ArrDelay < 0 ~ "Early",
      ArrDelay <= 15 ~ "On-Time",
      ArrDelay > 15 & ArrDelay < 30 ~ "Short Delay",
      ArrDelay >= 30 & ArrDelay < 45 ~ "Medium Delay",
      ArrDelay >= 45 ~ "Long Delay"))

# importing libraries for plotting bar graph
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)

# Converting year and delay category into factor before faceting 
flights_filtered$Year <- as.factor(flights_filtered$Year)
flights_filtered$delay_category <- as.factor(flights_filtered$delay_category)

# Arranging delay categories in order
flights_filtered$delay_category <- factor(flights_filtered$delay_category, 
    levels = c("Early", "On-Time", "Short Delay", "Medium Delay", "Long Delay"))

# Calculating percentage of each delay category for the different distance category flights each year for labelling bar graph
delay_perc <- flights_filtered %>%
  group_by(Year, delay_category) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

# Constructing faceted bar graph for the percentage and count of each delay category across years
bar1 <- ggplot(delay_perc, aes(x = delay_category, y = count, fill = delay_category)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Early" = "#66c2a5",
    "On-Time" = "#abdda4",
    "Short Delay" = "#fee08b",
    "Medium Delay" = "#fdae61",
    "Long Delay" = "#d53e4f"
  )) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8) +
  facet_grid( ~ Year) +
labs(title="Distribution of Flight Delays Across Years(2004 - 2008)", 
      x="Delay Category", 
      y="Count") +
theme_fivethirtyeight(base_size = 9) +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 20)
      ) +
scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0,4000000),
    breaks = seq(0,4000000, by = 500000),
    labels = scales::comma
  )

print(bar1)

# Extracting hour no. from DepTime and ArrTime 
flights_filtered$dep_hour <- floor(flights_filtered$DepTime / 100) 
flights_filtered$arr_hour <- floor(flights_filtered$ArrTime / 100) 

# Adding hr_grp column in flights_filtered dataframe, changing the dayofweek to factor and the different days for better readability, grouping them by year, dayofweek and hr_grp 
flights_filtered <- flights_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    hr_grp = cut(dep_hour,
                      breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24),
                      labels = c("0-2", "3-5", "6-8", "9-11", "12-14", "15-17", "18-20", "21-23"),
                      include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE),
         DayOfWeek = factor(DayOfWeek,levels = 1:7,
                            labels = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")),
         DayOfWeek = factor(DayOfWeek, levels = rev(levels(DayOfWeek)))
  )

# Grouping by year, DayofWeek and hr_grp for heatmap
arr_delay_heatmap <- flights_filtered %>%
  group_by(Year, DayOfWeek, hr_grp) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_arr_delay = mean(ArrDelay, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculating the average delay time per 3-hour for each year for benchmarking
block_benchmark <- flights_filtered %>%
  group_by(Year, hr_grp) %>%
  summarise(block_average_delay = mean(ArrDelay, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") 

# Merging benchmark into heatmap and adding levels for the delays for plotting 
arr_delay_heatmap <- arr_delay_heatmap %>%
  left_join(block_benchmark, by = c("Year", "hr_grp")) %>%
  mutate(
    delay_class = factor(case_when(
      avg_arr_delay < block_average_delay - 2 ~ "Below Average",
      avg_arr_delay > block_average_delay + 2 ~ "Above Average",
      abs(avg_arr_delay - block_average_delay) <= 2 ~ "Average",
      TRUE ~ "Average"
      ), levels = c("Below Average","Average", "Above Average"))
  )

# Assigning colours for each respective delay class
delay_colours <- c(
  "Below Average" = "#2ECC71",
  "Average" = "#F4D03f",
  "Above Average" = "#E74C3C"
)

# Creating benchmark labels for each year
overall_block_avg <- block_benchmark %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(overall_delay = round(mean(block_average_delay, na.rm = TRUE), 1), .groups = "drop")

# Defining order of delay levels
delay_levels <- c("Early", "On-Time", "Short Delay", "Medium Delay", "Long Delay")

# Adding block delay category for each 3-hour block according to delay caegories from before 
block_coloured <- block_benchmark %>%
  mutate(
    block_delay_category = case_when(
      block_average_delay < 0 ~ "Early",
      block_average_delay < 15 ~ "On-Time",
      block_average_delay < 30 ~ "Short Delay",
      block_average_delay < 45 ~ "Medium Delay",
      TRUE ~ "Long Delay"
    ),
    block_delay_category = factor(block_delay_category, levels = delay_levels)
  )

# Printing for each year for the averages of the hr_grp of each year & the overall average of the averages of the hour_grp 

library(tidyverse)

years <- 2004:2008

block_average_tables <- map(years, function(year_display) {
  block_coloured %>%
    filter(Year == year_display) %>%
    mutate(`Block Avg Delay` = round(block_average_delay, 1)) %>%
    select(hr_grp, `Block Avg Delay`, block_delay_category)
})

for (i in seq_along(block_average_tables)) {
  cat(paste0("\n===== Year: ", years[i], " =====\n"))
  print(block_average_tables[[i]])
}

# Calculate the overall block average delay for each year
overall_block_avg <- block_coloured %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(overall_delay = round(mean(block_average_delay, na.rm = TRUE), 1), .groups = "drop")

# Print the overall block average delay for each year
print(overall_block_avg)

# Constructing faceted heatmaps of the average arrival delay per airport, in 3-hour blocks each year
faceted_heatmap <- ggplot(arr_delay_heatmap, aes(x = hr_grp, y = DayOfWeek, fill = delay_class)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2, width = 1.05, height = 0.95) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_arr_delay, 2)), size = 2.7, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ Year) +
scale_fill_manual(
  values = delay_colours, 
  name = "Delay class :", 
  guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha =1))
) +
labs(
  title = "Heatmap of Avg Arrival Delay by Day in 3-Hour Blocks Each Year",
  x = "3-Hour Block",
  y = "Day of Week"
) +
theme_fivethirtyeight(base_size = 9) +
theme(
  panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
  legend.position = "top",
  plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 20)
)

print(faceted_heatmap)

# b) Evaluate if older planes suffer more delays on a yr-to-yr basis
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
# reading necessary plane datasets
planes_df <- read.csv("plane-data.csv", header = TRUE)

# there are 549 rows of empty data filled with spaces
sapply(planes_df, function(x) sum(x == "", na.rm = TRUE))

# trimming and removing rows with empty data in planes
planes_df <- planes_df %>% 
mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(trimws(.), ""))) 
planes_df <- na.omit(planes_df)  

# removing rows with "None" values, "0000" values of the "Year" and "issue_date" columns
planes_df$year[planes_df$year %in% c("None", "0000")] <- NA
planes_df$year <- as.numeric(planes_df$year)

planes_df <- planes_df %>%
filter(issue_date != "None" & !is.na(year)) 

# Creating a new column and combining the year, month and day to a date format (yyyy-mm-dd) in the flights_filtered dataframe
flights_filtered$flight_date <- as.Date(with(flights_filtered, 
                                             paste(Year, Month, DayofMonth, sep = "-")), 
                                        format = "%Y-%m-%d") 

# Converting issue date to date format (yyyy-mm-dd) 
planes_df$issue_date <- as.Date(planes_df$issue_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

# Renaming the tailnum column in planes_df to TailNum
planes_df <- planes_df %>% 
rename(TailNum = tailnum)

# Joining planes_df and flights_filtered dataframes by tailnum, adding the issue_date collumn of each plane
flights_filtered <- flights_filtered %>%
left_join(planes_df %>% select(TailNum, issue_date), by = "TailNum")

# Removing NA values in flights_filtered dataframe where the issue dates are not available for the respective TailNum
flights_filtered <- flights_filtered %>%
filter(!is.na(issue_date))

# Extracting the year of issue for the planes
flights_filtered$issue_year <- as.numeric(format(flights_filtered$issue_date, "%Y"))

# Calculating the plane age of the planes
flights_filtered$Year <- as.numeric(flights_filtered$Year)
flights_filtered$plane_age <- flights_filtered$Year - flights_filtered$issue_year

# categorising by age categories - new, mid-age & old
flights_filtered <- flights_filtered %>%
  group_by(TailNum, Year) %>%
  mutate(
    plane_age_category = case_when(
      plane_age >= 0 & plane_age <= 10 ~ "New",
      plane_age > 10 & plane_age < 20 ~ "Mid-age",
      plane_age >= 20 ~ "Old"
    )
  )

# Removing rows where flight_age less than or equal to 0 in flights_filtered dataframe
flights_filtered <- flights_filtered %>%
  filter(flight_age > 0)
  
# Organising the plane_age_category of new, mid-age and old
flights_filtered$plane_age_category <- factor(flights_filtered$plane_age_category, levels = c("New", "Mid-age", "Old"))

# Counting the number of new and old planes for all 5 years
planes_age_dist <- flights_filtered %>%
group_by(Year, plane_age_category) %>%
summarise(total_planes = n_distinct(TailNum), .groups = "drop") %>%
arrange(Year, plane_age_category)

print(planes_age_dist)

# Plotting line graphs for both new and old flight_age_category against the average arrival delay across the years
planes_age_summary <- flights_filtered %>%
  group_by(Year, plane_age_category) %>%
  summarise(avg_delay = mean(ArrDelay, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

planes_age_summary$plane_age_category <- factor(
  planes_age_summary$plane_age_category,
  levels = c("New", "Mid-age", "Old")
)

ggplot(planes_age_summary, aes(x = Year, y = avg_delay, color = as.factor(plane_age_category), group = plane_age_category)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 14), breaks = seq(0, 14, 2)) +
  labs(title = "Average Arrival Delays of New, Mid-age and Old Planes Across Years",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Average Arrival Delay (mins)",
       color = "Flight Age Category"
      ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 20)
  ) 
        
# Calculaing total distance, average arrival delay, and total flights per TailNum each year
util_df <- flights_filtered %>%
  group_by(TailNum, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_flights = n(),
    total_distance = sum(Distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_delay = mean(ArrDelay, na.rm = TRUE),
    plane_age = first(plane_age),
    plane_age_category = first(plane_age_category)
  )


# Standardising no.of flights and distance
util_df <- util_df %>%
  mutate(
    flights_z = scale(n_flights),
    distance_z = scale(total_distance)
  )

# Creating utilisation score to calculate utilisation of planes
util_df <- util_df %>%
  mutate(
    util_score = 0.5 * flights_z + 0.5 * distance_z
  )
  
# Categorising the utilisation scores - High, Medium & Low
util_df <- util_df %>%
  mutate(
    utilisation_category = case_when(
      util_score >= 1 ~ "High",
      util_score <= -1 ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ "Medium"
    )
  )

# Ordering the utilisation categories 
util_df$utilisation_category <- factor(
  util_df$utilisation_category,
  levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Plotting a scatter plot to see the correlation between the age of the planes & the utilisation score of each TailNum
ggplot(util_df, aes(x = plane_age, y = util_score, color = plane_age_category)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) + 
labs(
  title = "Flight Age to Utilisation Rate Of Planes ",
  x = "Flight Age (Years)",
  y = "Utilisation Score",
  color = "Plane Age Category"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
  plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 20),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
  legend.position = "bottom"
) 

# Calcualting the correlation between age of plane and util_score R value (Pearson correlation)
r_value <- cor(util_df$plane_age, util_df$util_score, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")

print(r_value)

# Constructing a heat map to show if the utilisation rate of a plane could also leads to longer delays of the plane
utils_to_delays <- util_df %>%
  group_by(plane_age_category, utilisation_category, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(
    group_avg_delay = mean(avg_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

utils_to_delays$plane_age_category <- factor(utils_to_delays$plane_age_category, levels = c("New", "Mid-age", "Old"))

ggplot(utils_to_delays, aes(x = util_group, y = plane_age_category, fill = group_avg_delay)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(group_avg_delay), "NA", round(group_avg_delay, 1))), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2ECC71", mid = "#F4D03F", high = "#E74C3C", midpoint = median(utils_to_delays$group_avg_delay, na.rm = TRUE), name = "Avg Arr Delay (mins)") +
labs(title = "Impact Of Plane Utilisation on Average Arrival Delays",
     x = "Utilisation Score Group",
     y = "Plane Age Category",
     fill = "Avg Arrival Delay (mins)"
     ) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 10), face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(r = 10), face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "right",   
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 20)
        ) 

# Performing ANOVA test for significant differences in average arrival delays across plane age categories
anova_model <- aov(avg_delay ~ flight_age_category, data = util_df)

summary(anova_model)

# Performing Tukey's HSD test for pairwise comparisons between plane age categories
TukeyHSD(anova_model)

# c) Fit a logistic regression model each year for the probability of diverted US flights using as many features available 

# Importing necessary libraries
library(yardstick)
library(maps)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidytext)
library(stringr)
library(PRROC)
library(pROC)
library(recipes)
library(rsample)
library(glmnet)
library(catboost)
library(ggridges)

# Changing diverted column to a factor
flights_df$Diverted <- as.factor(flights_df$Diverted)

# Removing cancelled flights from flights_df dataframe
div_df <- flights_df %>% 
filter(Cancelled == 0 & Diverted == 0 & DepTime < 2400 & ArrTime < 2400 | Diverted == 1)

# Calculating the proportion of diverted flights from the div_df dataframe for each year 
div_summary <- div_df %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    div_count = sum(Diverted == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    div_percent = (div_count / total_flights) * 100
)

print(div_summary)

# Importing carriers_df and airports_df for construction of model 
carriers_df <- read.csv("carriers.csv")
airports_df <- read.csv("airports.csv")

# creating a dataframe to select column in airports_df for the coordinates of the airports 
filtered_airports <- airports_df %>%
select(iata, lat, long)

# Merging coordinates column  for the destination airports into flights_df dataframe and removing unnecessary origin column in dataframe
div_df <- div_df %>%
left_join(filtered_airports %>% select(iata, lat, long), by = c("Dest" = "iata")) %>%
rename(dest_lat = lat, dest_long = long) %>%
select(-Origin) 

# Calculating the diversion rates for each airport using the the total arrivals of the respective airports, including the diverted flights 
airport_summary <- div_df %>%
  group_by(Year, Dest, dest_lat, dest_long) %>%
  summarise(
    total_arr = n(),
    div_arrivals = sum(Diverted == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    div_rate = div_arrivals / total_arr * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Extracting top 10 airports for each year in terms of diversion rates
top_ten_airports <- airport_summary %>%
  filter(total_arr >= 50) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = div_rate, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# plotting map with density plots for airports based on the number of diversions using the destination lat and long
ggplot(top_ten_airports, aes(x = dest_long, y = dest_lat)) +
  borders("state", colour = "gray50", fill = "gray85") +  
  geom_point(
  aes(size = total_arr, fill = div_rate), 
  shape = 21,              
  color = "black",         
  stroke = 0.3,            
  alpha = 0.8              
) +
scale_size_continuous(
  range = c(3, 7), 
  name = "Total No. of Arrivals"
) +
scale_fill_gradientn(
  colors = c("#00FF00", "#FFFF00", "#FFA500", "#FF4500",      "#8B0000"),  
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 10, 25, 50, 100)),              
  name = "Diversion Rate (%)"
) +
geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = Dest), max.overlaps = 100, size = 2.7,
  fontface = "bold", segment.size = 0.2, box.padding = 0.5,
  min.segment.length = 0, nudge_y = 0.7, direction = "both"
  ) +
coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-175, -60), ylim = c(15, 75)) + 
labs(
  title = " Top 10  US Destination Airports By Diversion Rate",
  subtitle = " Total No. of Arrival Flights is represented by Dot Size",
  x = "Longitude",
  y = "Latitude"
) +
facet_wrap(~ Year) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 20),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
  )

# Converting carriers to factors for construction of model
carriers_df$Code <- as.factor(carriers_df$Code)

# Changing the column name of the carrier in div_df for merging
div_df <- div_df %>%
rename(Code = UniqueCarrier)

# Merging carriers_df into div_df and replacing the unique carrier column with the carrier name
div_df <- div_df %>%
left_join(carriers_df %>% select(Code, Description), by = "Code") %>%
select(-Code) %>%
rename(carrier = Description)

# Converting diverted column in flights_df to numeric for construction of bar chart
div_df$Diverted <- as.numeric(as.character(flights_df$Diverted))

# Calculating diversion rates by carrier and year
carrier_div <- div_df %>%
  group_by(Year, carrier) %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    div_flights = sum(Diverted == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    div_rate = div_flights / total_flights,
    se = sqrt(div_rate * (1 - div_rate) / total_flights),
    ci_low = div_rate - 1.96 * se,
    ci_high = div_rate + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%

# Filter small samples 
  filter(total_flights >= 50)

# Extracting top 10 carriers per year
top_div_carriers <- carrier_div %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  slice_max(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()
  
# Shortening the carrier name for better plotting
top_div_carriers <- top_div_carriers %>%
  mutate(carrier = str_replace(
    carrier,
    "US Airways Inc\\. \\(Merged with America West 9/05\\. Reporting for both starting 10/07\\.\\)",
    "US Airways Inc."
  ))

# Constructing grouped bar graph for the number of diverted flights for the top 10 carriers within each year with the percentage of diversion labelled
ggplot(top_div_carriers, aes(x = div_rate, y = reorder(carrier, div_rate))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
    height = 0.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Year, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Top Carriers by Diversion Rate with 95% Confidence Intervals",
    x = "Diversion Rate (%)",
    y = "Carrier"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
# Extracting CRS departure and arrival hours from div_df for model
div_df$crs_dep_hour <- floor(div_df$CRSDepTime / 100) 
div_df$crs_arr_hour <- floor(div_df$CRSArrTime / 100)

# Replacing hr 24 value with 0 for the scheduled arrival and departure hour columns
div_df <- div_df %>%
  mutate(
    crs_arr_hour = if_else(crs_arr_hour == 24, 0, crs_arr_hour),
    crs_dep_hour = if_else(crs_dep_hour == 24, 0, crs_dep_hour)
  )

# Adding route column to div_df for inclusion to model
div_df <- div_df %>%
  mutate(route = paste(Origin, Dest, sep = "_"))

# Grouping routes by month and year and calculating the diversion rate for plotting
route_month_summary <- div_df %>%
  group_by(Year, route, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    div_flights = sum(Diverted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(div_rate = div_flights / total_flights * 100)

# Filtering routes to top 10 routes for each year and plotting heatmaps to visualise data
for (year in sort(unique(na.omit(div_df$Year)))) {
  div_year_df <- div_df %>%
    filter(Year == year)

  top_ten_routes <- div_year_df %>%
    count(route, sort = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    pull(route)

  route_year_df <- route_month_summary %>%
    filter(Year == year, route %in% top_ten_routes)

  route_sort <- route_year_df %>%
    group_by(route) %>%
    summarise(mean_div_rate = mean(div_rate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_div_rate)) %>%
    pull(route)

  vmin <- quantile(route_year_df$div_rate, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  vmax <- quantile(route_year_df$div_rate, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

  heatmap_df <- route_year_df %>%
    mutate(route = factor(route, levels = route_sort)) %>%
    complete(route, Month = 1:12)

  p <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = Month, y = route, fill = div_rate)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(div_rate), "", sprintf("%.3f", div_rate))), size = 3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month_names) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#ffffcc", "#fd8d3c", "#800026"),
      limits = c(vmin, vmax),
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Monthly Diversion Rate for Top 10 Busiest Routes in Year %d", as.integer(year)),
      x = "Month",
      y = "Route",
      fill = "Diversion Rate (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}

# Perform yearly Mann-Whitney U tests to compare dest arrival volume btwn diverted and non-diverted flights, and store the summary statistics
mw_results <- list()

for (year in sort(unique(na.omit(div_df$Year)))) {
  year_df <- div_df %>%
    filter(Year == year)

  not_diverted <- year_df %>%
    filter(Diverted == 0) %>%
    pull(dest_arrival_volume) %>%
    na.omit()

  diverted <- year_df %>%
    filter(Diverted == 1) %>%
    pull(dest_arrival_volume) %>%
    na.omit()

  test_result <- wilcox.test(not_diverted, diverted, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)

  median_not_div <- median(not_diverted)
  median_div <- median(diverted)
  median_diff <- median_div - median_not_div

  sig_label <- case_when(
    test_result$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    test_result$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    test_result$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )

  mw_results[[length(mw_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
    Year = as.integer(year),
    Median_Not_Diverted = round(median_not_div, 2),
    Median_Diverted = round(median_div, 2),
    Median_Difference = round(median_diff, 2),
    U_Statistic = round(as.numeric(test_result$statistic), 2),
    P_Value = test_result$p.value,
    Significance = sig_label
  )
}

mw_results_df <- bind_rows(mw_results)

# prettier p-value formatting
mw_results_df <- mw_results_df %>%
  mutate(
    P_Value = if_else(P_Value < 0.001, sprintf("%.3e", P_Value), sprintf("%.4f", P_Value)),
    U_Statistic = format(U_Statistic, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  )

colnames(mw_results_df) <- c(
  "Year",
  "Median (Not Diverted)",
  "Median (Diverted)",
  "Median Difference",
  "U Statistic",
  "P-Value",
  "Significance"
)

print(mw_results_df)

# defining features for model
feature_cols <- c(
  "crs_arr_hour", # identify as categorical since time of day is cyclical, so hr 23 and hr 0 are close
  "crs_dep_hour",
  "carrier",
  "route",
  "Distance",
  "CRSElapsedTime",
  "hist_route_div_rate_prev_years",
  "hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years",
  "Dest_arr_hr",
  "Dest",
  "Origin",
  "Origin_dep_hr",
  "Month", # identify as categorical since no linear relationship between div rate across months
  "dest_arrival_volume"
)

# Keep only available columns
feature_cols <- feature_cols[feature_cols %in% names(div_df)]

# Identifying categorical features for preprocessing
categorical_features <- c(
  "carrier", "crs_arr_hour", "crs_dep_hour",
  "route", "Dest", "Dest_arr_hr",
  "Origin", "Origin_dep_hr", "Month"
)
categorical_features <- categorical_features[categorical_features %in% feature_cols]

# Identifying numerical features for preprocessing
numeric_features <- c(
  "Distance", "CRSElapsedTime", "hist_route_div_rate_prev_years",
  "hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years", "dest_arrival_volume"
)
numeric_features <- numeric_features[numeric_features %in% feature_cols]


# One-hot encoding categorical features
categorical_transformer <- step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE)

# Standardize numerical features
numeric_transformer <- step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# Store yearly evaluation metrics, trained models, and permutation importance results
year_results <- list()
year_models <- list()
year_importances <- list()

# Training and evaluating yearly logistic regression models 
smoothing <- 100

numeric_features_model <- unique(c(
  numeric_features,
  "hist_route_div_rate_prev_years",
  "hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years"
))

for (year in sort(unique(na.omit(div_df$Year)))) {
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Training model for Year", as.integer(year), "\n")
  cat("==============================\n")

  year_model_df <- div_df %>% filter(Year == year)

  X <- year_model_df %>% select(all_of(feature_cols))
  y <- as.integer(year_model_df$Diverted)

  if (n_distinct(y) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", year, ": only one target class available.\n")
    next
  }

  split <- initial_split(year_model_df, prop = 0.7, strata = Diverted)
  train_data <- training(split)
  test_data <- testing(split)

  X_train <- train_data %>% select(all_of(feature_cols))
  X_test <- test_data %>% select(all_of(feature_cols))
  y_train <- as.integer(train_data$Diverted)
  y_test <- as.integer(test_data$Diverted)

# Use only 2004 training data since there is no historical data for 2004
  if (as.integer(year) == 2004) {
    fallback_rate <- mean(y_train)

    route_div_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$route, sum)
    route_total_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$route, length)

    dest_div_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$Dest, sum)
    dest_total_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$Dest, length)

# Use only previous years for later-year models
  } else {
    prev_data <- div_df %>% filter(Year < year)
    fallback_rate <- mean(prev_data$Diverted)

    route_div_flights <- prev_data %>%
      group_by(route) %>%
      summarise(n = sum(Diverted), .groups = "drop")

    route_total_flights <- prev_data %>%
      group_by(route) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

    dest_div_flights <- prev_data %>%
      group_by(Dest) %>%
      summarise(n = sum(Diverted), .groups = "drop")

    dest_total_flights <- prev_data %>%
      group_by(Dest) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  }

  if (as.integer(year) == 2004) {
    route_rate_map <- (route_div_flights + smoothing * fallback_rate) / (route_total_flights + smoothing)
    dest_rate_map <- (dest_div_flights + smoothing * fallback_rate) / (dest_total_flights + smoothing)

    X_train$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years <- route_rate_map[X_train$route]
    X_test$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years <- route_rate_map[X_test$route]

    X_train$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years <- dest_rate_map[X_train$Dest]
    X_test$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years <- dest_rate_map[X_test$Dest]
  } else {
    route_rate_map <- route_div_flights %>%
      left_join(route_total_flights, by = "route", suffix = c("_div", "_total")) %>%
      mutate(rate = (n_div + smoothing * fallback_rate) / (n_total + smoothing)) %>%
      select(route, rate)

    dest_rate_map <- dest_div_flights %>%
      left_join(dest_total_flights, by = "Dest", suffix = c("_div", "_total")) %>%
      mutate(rate = (n_div + smoothing * fallback_rate) / (n_total + smoothing)) %>%
      select(Dest, rate)

    X_train <- X_train %>%
      left_join(route_rate_map, by = "route") %>%
      rename(hist_route_div_rate_prev_years = rate)

    X_test <- X_test %>%
      left_join(route_rate_map, by = "route") %>%
      rename(hist_route_div_rate_prev_years = rate)

    X_train <- X_train %>%
      left_join(dest_rate_map, by = "Dest") %>%
      rename(hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years = rate)

    X_test <- X_test %>%
      left_join(dest_rate_map, by = "Dest") %>%
      rename(hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years = rate)
  }

  X_train$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_train$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate
  X_test$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_test$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate
  X_train$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_train$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate
  X_test$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_test$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate

  preprocessor <- recipe(Diverted ~ ., data = X_train %>% mutate(Diverted = factor(y_train, levels = c(0, 1)))) %>%
    step_novel(all_of(categorical_features)) %>%
    step_dummy(all_of(categorical_features), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
    step_normalize(all_of(c(
      numeric_features,
      "hist_route_div_rate_prev_years",
      "hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years"
    ))) %>%
    prep()

  clf <- glm(
    Diverted ~ .,
    data = juice(preprocessor),
    family = binomial(),
    weights = ifelse(
      y_train == 1,
      length(y_train) / (2 * sum(y_train == 1)),
      length(y_train) / (2 * sum(y_train == 0))
    )
  )

  y_prob <- predict(clf, bake(preprocessor, X_test), type = "response")
  y_pred <- ifelse(y_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0)

# Evaluation for this year
  cat("\nConfusion Matrix:\n")
  print(table(Actual = y_test, Predicted = y_pred))

  year_results[[as.character(year)]] <- tibble(
    Year = as.integer(year),
    precision = precision_vec(factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), factor(y_pred, levels = c(0, 1)), event_level = "second"),
    recall = recall_vec(factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), factor(y_pred, levels = c(0, 1)), event_level = "second"),
    f1 = f_meas_vec(factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), factor(y_pred, levels = c(0, 1)), event_level = "second"),
    pr_auc = pr_auc_vec(factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), y_prob, event_level = "second"),
    roc_auc = roc_auc_vec(factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), y_prob, event_level = "second")
  )

year_models[[as.character(year)]] <- list(
  preprocessor = preprocessor,
  model = clf
)

# Permutation importance for this year
  baseline_pr_auc <- pr_auc_vec(factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), y_prob, event_level = "second")

  importance_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(X_test), function(feature) {
    scores <- replicate(5, {
      X_test_perm <- X_test
      X_test_perm[[feature]] <- sample(X_test_perm[[feature]])
      y_prob_perm <- predict(clf, bake(preprocessor, X_test_perm), type = "response")
      baseline_pr_auc - pr_auc_vec(factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), y_prob_perm, event_level = "second")
    })

    tibble(
      feature = feature,
      importance_mean = mean(scores),
      importance_std = sd(scores)
    )
  })) %>%
    arrange(desc(importance_mean))

  year_importances[[as.character(year)]] <- importance_df

  cat("\nPermutation Importance for Year", as.integer(year), ":\n")
  print(importance_df)

  ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = importance_mean, y = reorder(feature, importance_mean))) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4c78a8") +
    labs(
      x = "Permutation Importance using PR-AUC",
      y = "Feature",
      title = paste("Feature Importance for Diversion Prediction, Year", as.integer(year))
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Saving Logistic Regression model results into year_results_df
year_results_df <- bind_rows(year_results)

# Saving the year_results_df as a csv
write.csv(year_results_df, "logistic_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Extract encoded categorical and numerical feature names and logistic regression coef for each yearly model
coef_rows <- list()

for (year in names(year_models)) {
  clf <- year_models[[year]]
  preprocessor <- clf$preprocessor
  log_reg <- clf$model

  train_processed <- juice(preprocessor)
  feature_names <- setdiff(names(train_processed), "Diverted")
  coefs <- as.numeric(stats::coef(log_reg)[-1])

  temp_df <- data.frame(
    Year = as.integer(year),
    encoded_feature = feature_names,
    coefficient = coefs
  )

  coef_rows[[year]] <- temp_df
}

head(coef_df)

# Map categorical feature names back to original feature groups
prefix_map <- list(
  c("cat__Dest_arr_hr_", "Dest_arr_hr"),
  c("cat__Origin_dep_hr_", "Origin_dep_hr"),
  c("cat__crs_arr_hour_", "crs_arr_hour"),
  c("cat__crs_dep_hour_", "crs_dep_hour"),
  c("cat__carrier_", "carrier"),
  c("cat__route_", "route"),
  c("cat__Dest_", "Dest"),
  c("cat__Origin_", "Origin"),
  c("cat__Month_", "Month")
)

# Assign each encoded categorical feature to its corresponding feature group
map_feature_group <- function(encoded_name) {
  if (startsWith(encoded_name, "num__")) {
    return(sub("^num__", "", encoded_name))
  }

  for (i in seq_along(prefix_map)) {
    prefix <- prefix_map[[i]][1]
    group_name <- prefix_map[[i]][2]

    if (startsWith(encoded_name, prefix)) {
      return(group_name)
    }
  }

  encoded_name
}

# Grouping categorical and numeric coefficient names into original features
coef_df$feature_group <- sapply(coef_df$encoded_feature, map_feature_group)

# Defining function for plotting ridgeline of each categorical feature across the years
plot_categorical_kde <- function(feature_name) {
  plot_df <- coef_df[coef_df$feature_group == feature_name, ]

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    cat("No coefficients found for feature group:", feature_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  plot_df$Year <- as.character(plot_df$Year)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = coefficient, y = Year, fill = Year)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Coefficient Distribution Across Years:", feature_name),
      x = "Coefficient Value",
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Running CatBoost model with same features for better identification of flight diversions (precision & recall)
cat_year_results <- list()
cat_year_models <- list()
cat_year_importances <- list()

for (year in sort(unique(na.omit(div_df$Year)))) {
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Training CatBoost for Year", as.integer(year), "\n")
  cat("==============================\n")

  year_model_df <- div_df %>% filter(Year == year)

  X <- year_model_df[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE]
  y <- as.integer(year_model_df$Diverted)

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(y) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", year, ": only one target class available.\n")
    next
  }

  set.seed(42)
  split <- initial_split(year_model_df, prop = 0.7, strata = Diverted)
  train_data <- training(split)
  test_data <- testing(split)

  X_train <- train_data[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE]
  X_test <- test_data[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- as.integer(train_data$Diverted)
  y_test <- as.integer(test_data$Diverted)

  smoothing <- 100

  if (as.integer(year) == 2004) {
    fallback_rate <- mean(y_train)

    route_div_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$route, sum)
    route_total_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$route, length)

    dest_div_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$Dest, sum)
    dest_total_flights <- tapply(y_train, X_train$Dest, length)

  } else {
    prev_data <- div_df %>% filter(Year < year)
    fallback_rate <- mean(prev_data$Diverted)

    route_div_flights <- tapply(prev_data$Diverted, prev_data$route, sum)
    route_total_flights <- tapply(prev_data$Diverted, prev_data$route, length)

    dest_div_flights <- tapply(prev_data$Diverted, prev_data$Dest, sum)
    dest_total_flights <- tapply(prev_data$Diverted, prev_data$Dest, length)
  }

  route_rate_map <- (route_div_flights + smoothing * fallback_rate) /
    (route_total_flights + smoothing)

  dest_rate_map <- (dest_div_flights + smoothing * fallback_rate) /
    (dest_total_flights + smoothing)

  X_train$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years <- route_rate_map[as.character(X_train$route)]
  X_test$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years <- route_rate_map[as.character(X_test$route)]

  X_train$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years <- dest_rate_map[as.character(X_train$Dest)]
  X_test$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years <- dest_rate_map[as.character(X_test$Dest)]

  X_train$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_train$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate
  X_test$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_test$hist_route_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate

  X_train$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_train$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate
  X_test$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years[is.na(X_test$hist_dest_div_rate_prev_years)] <- fallback_rate

  for (col in categorical_features) {
    X_train[[col]] <- as.factor(X_train[[col]])
    X_test[[col]] <- as.factor(X_test[[col]])
  }

  train_pool <- catboost.load_pool(data = X_train, label = y_train)
  test_pool <- catboost.load_pool(data = X_test, label = y_test)

  cat_model <- catboost.train(
    learn_pool = train_pool,
    params = list(
      iterations = 500,
      learning_rate = 0.05,
      depth = 6,
      loss_function = "Logloss",
      eval_metric = "PRAUC",
      auto_class_weights = "Balanced",
      random_seed = 42,
      verbose = 100
    )
  )

  pred_prob <- catboost.predict(cat_model, test_pool, prediction_type = "Probability")
  y_prob <- if (is.matrix(pred_prob)) pred_prob[, 2] else as.numeric(pred_prob)
  y_pred <- ifelse(y_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0)

  cat("\nConfusion Matrix:\n")
  print(table(Actual = y_test, Predicted = y_pred))

  eval_df <- data.frame(
    truth = factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)),
    estimate = factor(y_pred, levels = c(0, 1)),
    .pred_1 = y_prob
  )

  pr_auc <- pr_auc_vec(eval_df$truth, eval_df$.pred_1, event_level = "second")
  roc_auc <- roc_auc_vec(eval_df$truth, eval_df$.pred_1, event_level = "second")

  cat_year_results[[as.character(year)]] <- data.frame(
    precision = precision_vec(eval_df$truth, eval_df$estimate, event_level = "second"),
    recall = recall_vec(eval_df$truth, eval_df$estimate, event_level = "second"),
    f1 = f_meas_vec(eval_df$truth, eval_df$estimate, event_level = "second"),
    pr_auc = pr_auc,
    roc_auc = roc_auc
  )

  cat_year_models[[as.character(year)]] <- cat_model

  importance_df <- data.frame(
    feature = names(X_train),
    importance = catboost.get_feature_importance(cat_model)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(importance))

  cat_year_importances[[as.character(year)]] <- importance_df

  cat("\nFeature Importance for Year", as.integer(year), ":\n")
  print(importance_df)

  rm(X, y, X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, cat_model, y_prob, y_pred, year_model_df, importance_df)
  gc()
}

# Saving cat_year_results into cat_results_df
cat_results_df <- bind_rows(cat_year_results, .id = "Year")

cat_results_df$Year <- as.integer(cat_results_df$Year)
cat_results_df

# Saving the catboost model results into a csv file
write.csv(cat_results_df, "catboost_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Reading results of models 
logistic_results_df <- read.csv("logistic_results.csv")
cat_results_df <- read.csv("catboost_results.csv")

# Merging result tables for plotting
comparison_df <- logistic_results_df %>%
  rename(
    `Logistic Precision` = precision,
    `Logistic Recall` = recall,
    `Logistic F1` = f1,
    `Logistic PR-AUC` = pr_auc
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    cat_results_df %>%
      rename(
        `CatBoost Precision` = precision,
        `CatBoost Recall` = recall,
        `CatBoost F1` = f1,
        `CatBoost PR-AUC` = pr_auc
      ),
    by = "Year"
  )

# Loading baseline diversion rates across years into dictionary
baseline_rates <- setNames(div_summary$div_percent / 100, div_summary$Year)

# Mapping baseline rates to each year in comparison_df and calculating PR_AUC lift for each model
comparison_df$`Baseline Rate` <- baseline_rates[as.character(comparison_df$Year)]

comparison_df$`Logistic PR-AUC Lift` <- comparison_df$`Logistic PR-AUC` / comparison_df$`Baseline Rate`

comparison_df$`CatBoost PR-AUC Lift` <- comparison_df$`CatBoost PR-AUC` / comparison_df$`Baseline Rate`

# Formatting presentation of values of PR_AUC lift
comparison_df$`Logistic PR-AUC Lift` <- sprintf("%.1fx", comparison_df$`Logistic PR-AUC Lift`)
comparison_df$`CatBoost PR-AUC Lift` <- sprintf("%.1fx", comparison_df$`CatBoost PR-AUC Lift`)

# Defining column names for clean plotting of table
comparison_df <- comparison_df[, c(
  "Year",
  "Baseline Rate",
  "Logistic Recall",
  "CatBoost Recall",
  "Logistic Precision",
  "CatBoost Precision",
  "Logistic PR-AUC",
  "Logistic PR-AUC Lift",
  "CatBoost PR-AUC",
  "CatBoost PR-AUC Lift"
)]

# Renaming column names and rounding off values to 4dp for cleaner table
comparison_df <- comparison_df %>%
  rename(
    `Base Rate` = `Baseline Rate`,
    `LR Recall` = `Logistic Recall`,
    `CB Recall` = `CatBoost Recall`,
    `LR Prec` = `Logistic Precision`,
    `CB Prec` = `CatBoost Precision`,
    `LR PR-AUC` = `Logistic PR-AUC`,
    `LR Lift` = `Logistic PR-AUC Lift`,
    `CB PR-AUC` = `CatBoost PR-AUC`,
    `CB Lift` = `CatBoost PR-AUC Lift`
  )

comparison_df <- comparison_df %>%
  mutate(
    `Base Rate` = round(`Base Rate`, 4),
    `LR Recall` = round(`LR Recall`, 4),
    `CB Recall` = round(`CB Recall`, 4),
    `LR Prec` = round(`LR Prec`, 4),
    `CB Prec` = round(`CB Prec`, 4),
    `LR PR-AUC` = round(`LR PR-AUC`, 4),
    `CB PR-AUC` = round(`CB PR-AUC`, 4)
  )

comparison_df
